#include <stdlib.h>
struct Node{int value;struct Node*next;};struct Node*build(int n){struct Node*head=0;for(int i=0;i<n;i++){struct Node*p=calloc(1,sizeof(struct Node));if(!p){return head;}p->value=i;p->next=head;head=p;}return head;}long long consume(struct Node*q,int seed){long long total=seed;long long count=0;while(q){struct Node*tail=q->next;count+=1;total+=q->value+count;free(q);q=tail;}return total+count;}long long entry(int n,int delta){struct Node*head=build(n);return consume(head,delta);}

#include <stdlib.h>
struct Node{int value;struct Node*next;};struct Node*build(int n){struct Node*head=0;for(int i=0;i<n;i++){struct Node*p=calloc(1,sizeof(struct Node));if(!p){return head;}p->value=i;p->next=head;head=p;}return head;}long long consume(struct Node*q,int seed){long long total=seed;long long history=0;while(q){struct Node*tail=q->next;total+=q->value;history+=total;free(q);q=tail;}return total+history;}long long entry(int n,int delta){struct Node*head=build(n);return consume(head,delta);}

request.source:
#include <stdlib.h>
struct Node{int value;struct Node*next;};struct Node*build(int n){struct Node*head=0;for(int i=0;i<n;i++){struct Node*p=calloc(1,sizeof(struct Node));if(!p){return head;}p->value=i;p->next=head;head=p;}return head;}long long consume(struct Node*q,int seed){long long total=seed;long long history=0;while(q){struct Node*tail=q->next;total+=q->value;history+=total;free(q);q=tail;}return total+history;}struct Node*flip(struct Node*head){struct Node*prev=0;while(head){struct Node*next=head->next;head->next=prev;prev=head;head=next;}return prev;}long long entry(int n,int delta){struct Node*head=build(n);head=flip(head);return consume(head,delta);}

#include <stdlib.h>
struct Node{int value;struct Node*next;};struct Node*build(int n){struct Node*head=0;for(int i=0;i<n;i++){struct Node*p=calloc(1,sizeof(struct Node));if(!p){return head;}p->value=i;p->next=head;head=p;}return head;}long long consume(struct Node*q,int seed){long long total=seed;while(q){struct Node*tail=q->next;total=-total+q->value;free(q);q=tail;}return total;}long long entry(int n,int delta){struct Node*head=build(n);return consume(head,delta);}

request.source:
#include <stdlib.h>
struct Node{int value;struct Node*next;};struct Node*build(int n){struct Node*head=0;for(int i=0;i<n;i++){struct Node*p=calloc(1,sizeof(struct Node));if(!p){return head;}p->value=i;p->next=head;head=p;}return head;}long long consume(struct Node*q,int seed){_Bool flag=seed;while(q){struct Node*tail=q->next;flag=!flag;free(q);q=tail;}return flag;}long long entry(int n,int delta){struct Node*head=build(n);return consume(head,delta);}

#include <stdlib.h>
struct Node{int value;struct Node*next;};struct Node*build(int n){struct Node*head=0;for(int i=0;i<n;i++){struct Node*p=calloc(1,sizeof(struct Node));if(!p){return head;}p->value=i;p->next=head;head=p;}return head;}long long consume(struct Node*q,int seed){long long total=seed;while(q){struct Node*tail=q->next;total+=1;total+=1;total+=1;total+=1;total+=1;total+=1;total+=1;total+=1;total+=1;total+=1;total+=1;total+=1;total+=1;total+=1;total+=1;total+=1;free(q);q=tail;}return total;}long long entry(int n,int delta){struct Node*head=build(n);return consume(head,delta);}

#include <stdlib.h>
struct Node{int value;struct Node*next;};struct Node*build(int n){struct Node*head=0;for(int i=0;i<n;i++){struct Node*p=calloc(1,sizeof(struct Node));if(!p){return head;}p->value=i;p->next=head;head=p;}return head;}unsigned char consume(struct Node*q,int seed){long long total=seed;long long count=0;while(q){struct Node*tail=q->next;count+=1;total+=q->value+count;free(q);q=tail;}return total+count;}long long entry(int n,int delta){struct Node*head=build(n);return (signed char)consume(head,delta);}

request.source:
#include <stdlib.h>
struct Node{int value;struct Node*next;};struct Node*build(int n){struct Node*head=0;for(int i=0;i<n;i++){struct Node*p=calloc(1,sizeof(struct Node));if(!p){return head;}p->value=i;p->next=head;head=p;}return head;}long long consume(struct Node*q,int seed){long long total=seed;long long history=0;while(q){struct Node*tail=q->next;total+=q->value;history+=total;free(q);q=tail;}return total+history;}void map(struct Node*q,int d){while(q){q->value=q->value+d;q=q->next;}}struct Node*flip(struct Node*head){struct Node*prev=0;while(head){struct Node*next=head->next;head->next=prev;prev=head;head=next;}return prev;}long long entry(int n,int delta){struct Node*head=build(n+1);map(head,delta);head=flip(head);return consume(head,delta+1);}
